main.summary: Coordinates transfer ownership with PostgreSQL advisory locks.

field.name: dataSource
field.summary: Configured PostgreSQL data source used to open connections for advisory locks.

constructor.name: PostgresDataItemTransferCoordinator
constructor.param: Configured PostgreSQL data source used to open advisory-lock connections.

method.name: AcquireLockAsync
method.summary: Opens a PostgreSQL connection and acquires an advisory lock for a namespaced identifier.
method.returns: An owned lock handle that releases the advisory lock and connection when disposed.

method.name: AcquireAdvisoryLockAsync
method.summary: Acquire an advisory lock on an existing connection.
method.param: Connection that will own the lock.

method.name: ComputeLockKey
method.summary: Computes the PostgreSQL advisory-lock key for a namespaced identifier.
method.param: Identifier to include in the lock key.

main.summary: Owns the item and session advisory locks for one transfer mutation scope.

field.name: lease
field.summary: Lease owning both advisory locks and their connection.

field.name: released
field.summary: Tracks whether the scope has released its locks.

constructor.name: TransferMutationScope
constructor.summary: Initializes a mutation scope with its acquired item and session locks.
constructor.param: Item identifier protected by the scope.
Session identifier protected by the scope.

property.name: ItemID
property.summary: Gets the item identifier protected by the scope.

property.name: SessionID
property.summary: Gets the session identifier protected by the scope.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Releases the session lock and then the item lock once.

main.summary: Owns an item lock and optionally a session lock on one PostgreSQL connection.

field.name: dataSource
field.summary: Data source that owns the connection pool.

field.name: connection
field.summary: Connection that owns the advisory locks.

field.name: gate
field.summary: Serializes acquisition and disposal of the lease.

field.name: sessionKey
field.summary: Acquired session advisory-lock key, if any.

field.name: released
field.summary: Tracks whether the connection has been released.

constructor.name: PostgresItemLockLease
constructor.summary: Initializes a lease for an acquired item lock.
constructor.param: Data source that owns the connection pool.
Connection that owns the item lock.

method.name: ReleaseLockAsync
method.summary: Release an advisory lock held by the lease connection.

main.summary: Owns one PostgreSQL advisory lock and its connection.

field.name: connection
field.summary: The PostgreSQL connection that owns the advisory lock.

field.name: released
field.summary: Tracks whether the lock has been released.

constructor.name: PostgresLock
constructor.summary: Initializes an owned PostgreSQL advisory lock.
constructor.param: Connection that owns the advisory lock.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Releases the PostgreSQL advisory lock and disposes its connection once.
